subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “On a small island, students go to school by boat.”?
options: The clock above the school office was always five minutes fast.
During the trip, they visited an old town with many narrow streets.
When the sea is calm, the trip takes fifteen minutes.
Still, after ten minutes, the button was back on the shirt.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The clock above the school office was always five minutes fast.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「During the trip, they visited an old town with many narrow streets.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「When the sea is calm, the trip takes fifteen minutes.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Still, after ten minutes, the button was back on the shirt.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「When the sea is calm, the trip takes fifteen minutes.」，答案為「When the sea is calm, the trip takes fifteen minutes.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When the sea is calm, the trip takes fifteen minutes.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
